title: Send this to someone who thinks Miami is just beaches
igCaption:
Only real Miami people know these 👀 Send this to someone who thinks Miami is just beaches

Miami is the only major US city founded by a woman
Biscayne National Park is about 95% water
Elliott Key is made of fossilized coral reef
Key Largo has the first underwater park in the US

How many did you know? Comment your number.

#Miami #SouthFlorida #FloridaKeys #MiamiFacts

scenes.text: Only real Miami people know these. Send this to someone who thinks Miami is just beaches.
scenes.caption: Only real Miami people know these. Send this to someone who thinks Miami is just beaches.

scenes.text: Miami was founded by a woman. Julia Tuttle owned the land the city was built on. She's the only woman to found a major American city.
scenes.caption: Miami was founded by a woman. Julia Tuttle owned the land the city was built on. She's the only woman to found a major American city.

scenes.text: South of Miami, there's a national park that's almost all water. Biscayne National Park covers about a hundred seventy-three thousand acres. Only about nine thousand are land.
scenes.caption: South of Miami, there's a national park that's almost all water. Biscayne National Park covers about a hundred seventy-three thousand acres. Only about nine thousand are land.

scenes.text: Inside it is Elliott Key. It's the northernmost true Florida Key. The whole island formed from fossilized coral reef.
scenes.caption: Inside it is Elliott Key. It's the northernmost true Florida Key. The whole island formed from fossilized coral reef.

scenes.text: And in Key Largo is John Pennekamp Coral Reef State Park. It was the first underwater park in the United States.
scenes.caption: And in Key Largo is John Pennekamp Coral Reef State Park. It was the first underwater park in the United States.
